assertion.statement: The actual CM elliptic curve of every permitted old conductor d has supersingular geometric reduction at the new inert prime ell, including every old ideal-class translate.
assertion.objects: The proper O_d ideal CM curves in the finite Heegner construction; Delta=d^2 D_K.
assertion.hypotheses: ell lies outside6dND_K and is inert in K; the actual curve has CM by O_d as supplied by the compatible CM construction.
assertion.quantifiers: Every such CM invariant and every prime above ell.
assertion.parameter_range: All permitted old d, including nonmaximal orders.
assertion.uniformity: All primes above ell and all ideal classes with that order discriminant.
assertion.normalizations: (Delta/ell)=(D_K/ell)=-1 because ell does not divide d.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Only supersingularity is supplied, not the smooth modular model, raising-kernel specialization or extension of pi.
assertion.limit_order: Fix the CM order and prime, verify its discriminant symbol, then apply the reduction criterion.

use.reason: Verifies the order-discriminant symbol for arbitrary old conductor before applying the exact general published reduction statement.
use.shared_contract_justification: Main3840–3842 and note33–37 refer to the same CM order and inert new prime; only their supersingularity clause is supplied.

supplier.statement: For an imaginary quadratic argument with order discriminant Delta, if (Delta/ell)=-1, its CM elliptic curve has supersingular reduction at every prime above ell in K(j).

available_assertion.objects: Imaginary quadratic argument tau, j(tau), its order O and order discriminant Delta.
available_assertion.hypotheses: The quadratic residue symbol (Delta/ell) equals -1; reduction is the geometric CM reduction.
available_assertion.quantifiers: Every such CM invariant and every prime above ell.
available_assertion.parameter_range: The general forward reduction sentence; no restriction to fundamental Delta or the subsequent small-prime congruences.
available_assertion.uniformity: All primes above ell and all ideal classes with that order discriminant.
available_assertion.normalizations: Delta denotes the order discriminant, not necessarily the field discriminant.
available_assertion.exceptional_cases: No ramified or split reduction assertion is used; the later fundamental-discriminant lifting statement is separate.
available_assertion.limit_order: Fix the CM order and prime, verify its discriminant symbol, then apply the reduction criterion.
